requiredConcepts.concept: Section 52-61 generally requires the building thereafter to be used only for a conforming use after active operation of substantially all non-conforming uses is discontinued continuously for two years.
The owner's intent to resume active operations does not preserve the use under the general rule.
Thirty continuous months exceeds the section's two-year period.
The answer checks the express governmental-project, vacant-store, transient-hotel, and other stated exceptions before reaching a project-specific conclusion.

findings.reviewDetail: The answer states the substantially-all active-operation and continuous two-year conditions, applies 30 months, rejects intent as preserving the use and identifies the express exception groups. Its main conclusion is expressly subject to those exceptions; this meets the current reference.

requiredConcepts.concept: Section 77-11's majority-district use treatment applies only to qualifying zoning lots existing on December 15, 1961 or on the date of an applicable subsequent amendment.
For the stated lot created in 2026, Section 77-02 generally regulates each portion under the district in which it is located.
Section 77-22 separately applies an adjusted maximum FAR calculation to divided zoning lots created at any time.
The answer distinguishes use-regulation treatment from the separate adjusted-FAR mechanism.

issues.observed: After accurately reciting the effective-date condition, this point conclusively selects Section 77-02 from the 2026 assembly year alone.
issues.whyItMatters: No applicable subsequent amendment date is supplied. Assembly year alone does not establish whether the lot existed on such an amendment date. The main answer is conditional, but this supporting point treats that unresolved condition as established.
issues.expected: Keep the portion-by-portion application conditional on the lot not having existed on the applicable effective or amendment date. The direct answer that majority area alone does not automatically control can remain definite.

findings.reviewDetail: The main answer correctly rejects automatic majority treatment, preserves the date and distance conditions and separates FAR. All required citations are present and the FAR point binds both 77-02 and 77-22. The supporting application makes the date-dependent branch more definite than the supplied facts warrant. Automated deterministic verification accepted it.
